evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads 433.8 °C, markedly inconsistent with the other column temperatures of approximately 64–72 °C.
T701 has risen to 442.7 °C while all other measured column temperatures remain between 63.5 and 73.3 °C; a temperature-measurement fault versus actual excessive reboiler temperature is unresolved.
System pressure is 499.6 mbar and differential pressures are 0.6 and 2.8 mbar, consistent with their earlier ranges; no corroborating pressure excursion.
Reflux flow is 0.7 L/h, distillate flow is zero, and reported ratio is zero; flows have mostly been near zero, but expected operating-phase setpoints are unavailable.

args.missing_evidence: Independently verify reboiler temperature and T701 calibration/scaling to distinguish actual overheating from a measurement fault; obtain protocol temperature limits, operating phase and flow setpoints. No composition measurement or target separation criterion has been provided.
